```python
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

def get_jaychou_lyrics(song_name):
    # Search KKBox for the song (Chinese input required)
    url = f"https://www.kkbox.com/tw/zh/search?q={song_name}"
    headers = {
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"
    }

    try:
        response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')

        # Find the lyrics link (KKBox's structure may change; inspect element)
        lyrics_link = soup.find("a", {"data-testid": "song-lyrics-link"})
        if lyrics_link:
            lyrics_url = "https://www.kkbox.com" + lyrics_link["href"]
            lyrics_response = requests.get(lyrics_url, headers=headers)
            lyrics_soup = BeautifulSoup(lyrics_response.text, 'html.parser')
            lyrics = lyrics_soup.find("div", {"class": "lyrics"}).get_text()
            return lyrics
        else:
            return "Lyrics not found on KKBox. Try another platform."
    except Exception as e:
        return f"Error: {e}"

# Example usage (replace with the actual song name in Chinese)

```
